data.one_liner: Format definition and support for parsing build.yaml configuration.
data.what_it_does: Provides support for parsing and defining the configuration format used by build_runner in build.yaml files. It allows configuring build targets, builders, post-process builders, and global options.
use_when: You are developing a build system tool or extension that needs to parse build.yaml files.
You need to understand or implement build_runner configuration parsing in Dart.
avoid_when: You are just writing a standard Flutter application and do not need to parse custom build configurations.
strengths: Direct support for build.yaml format parsing.
Handles complex configurations like targets, global options, and post-process builders.
weaknesses: Niche utility specific to build_runner ecosystem.
